rubric_items.reason: Lists the api, web and db modules, the three routes and both tables. It misses the window/time-zone helpers and other readers of the changed doctor detail response.
Every module, route, table, index and symbol id appears in the generated facts and is cited. All 15 claims check out against the facts and context sections.

Covers jobs (none) and the dashboard and appointment list as related readers. It does not consider other readers of GET /api/doctors/:id, such as the /doctors/:id/edit form (DoctorFormPage.fromDoctor).
Statuses are justified and the gaps (filters, PERIODS values) are raised as unknowns U-1 and U-2 with questions. The doctor detail route is marked changed while leaving room for a separate read.
Readable and short. The 'Impacted modules' section mixes modules, APIs and tables, and items are not ordered by risk.

findings.text: GET /api/doctors/:id is marked changed, but the analysis does not list its other readers. The facts show a /doctors/:id/edit route and DoctorFormPage.fromDoctor, which probably maps the doctor response. Adding a field could affect that form or the PATCH round-trip.
findings.suggested_fix: List DoctorFormPage (/doctors/:id/edit) and any other readers of the doctor detail response as existing readers, and say whether the new field has to stay out of the edit/PATCH path.

findings.text: REQ-2 and REQ-3 need a 30-day window up to end of today in HOSPITAL_TZ. The facts show shared time helpers in api/src/lib/time.ts (dayBounds, localDay, zonedToUtc) and in web/src/lib/format.ts (todayIn), but the analysis does not name them as reused or touched.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the time helpers (api lib/time.ts, web lib/format.ts todayIn) as existing dependencies of the window computation and of the link's date filter.

findings.text: The default for Q-02 is to share the dashboard's window computation, which means refactoring DashboardService. Yet /api/dashboard is listed only as 'existing' and DashboardService is not called out as a code change that needs a regression check.

cites.quote: Default: design reads dashboardService.ts and shares the window computation.
http:GET:/api/dashboard — existing: source of the Last 30 days rule; its response must not change.

findings.suggested_fix: State that DashboardService may be refactored to extract the shared window rule, and that the dashboard No-shows tile needs a regression check.

findings.text: The 'Impacted modules' section mixes modules, APIs and tables in one list and does not order items by risk.

cites.quote: table:appointment — existing: read by doctor_id, status NO_SHOW and starts_at window.

findings.suggested_fix: Split the list into Modules, APIs and Tables, and order each by risk (the REQ-4 drift and the Q-01 filters first).
